purpose: Make authorized first-time-user evaluation of the local GUI first-session workflow actionable without recording participant results or implying release approval.

audience_and_use_case.supporting_users: facilitators helping with a bounded local session
audience_and_use_case.job_to_be_done: launch or load a session, identify the next visible action, complete the host-mediated first-month handoffs, recover from friction, and report comprehension
audience_and_use_case.default_setup: local loopback host, Chromium, 1024x768 planning baseline, audio optional
audience_and_use_case.facilitator_boundary: provide setup, consent, stop, and recovery guidance without teaching hidden state or promising outcomes

source_contract.recovery_guidance: docs/guides/gui-how-to-play.md: Use **Retry current read** when offered.

technical_contract.authority: The Rust host owns session creation, campaign decisions, validation, submission, resolution, history, and refreshed observations; the browser stores only local presentation preferences and draft UI state.

participant_tasks.prompt: Starting from the local GUI, launch or load a competitive session and describe what you know and what the interface asks you to do next.
participant_tasks.technical_success_observation: The host-bound launch surface exposes campaign, seed, difficulty, start/load, and a polite status region before the first observation.
participant_tasks.human_measure: participant identifies the next action without facilitator explanation

participant_tasks.prompt: Follow the visible first-month rail through inspect, draft, validation, submission, resolution, and continuation.
participant_tasks.technical_success_observation: The seven source-defined stages advance only after the corresponding host-bound handoff and refreshed observation.
participant_tasks.human_measure: participant completes the path, describes the visible result, and distinguishes a draft from a committed outcome

participant_tasks.prompt: When a submission is rejected, a read is unavailable, or storage is unavailable, use the visible recovery guidance and continue without inventing an outcome.
participant_tasks.technical_success_observation: Rejected work remains recoverable, retry guidance is present, storage guidance is documented, and the browser does not advance the host-owned state locally.
participant_tasks.human_measure: participant chooses a safe recovery action and retains trust in the displayed state

participant_tasks.prompt: Start or load a supported campaign-coverage session and identify the visible stage, actors, processes, decisions, history, and debrief before choosing a host decision.
participant_tasks.technical_success_observation: The five source-defined campaign-coverage stages advance only after host refresh and retain written actor-visible context.
participant_tasks.human_measure: participant can distinguish a host-shaped decision from a local prediction or hidden-state claim

participant_tasks.prompt: Try Large text, reduced motion, audio-off or cues-only, and keyboard/skip/review accommodations, then repeat a comprehension question.
participant_tasks.technical_success_observation: The documented presentation preferences and written equivalents remain available without changing host commands or simulation state.
participant_tasks.human_measure: participant retains the same decision-relevant meaning under the selected accommodation

review_questions: Can a first-time player identify how to launch or load a session and what to do next without implementation knowledge?
Can a first-time player complete the seven competitive first-month handoffs while distinguishing draft, validation, submission, and committed resolution?
Can a player recover from rejection or an unavailable read without losing work, inventing an outcome, or needing hidden-state instruction?
Can a player recognize the five campaign-coverage orientation stages and distinguish a host-shaped decision from a local prediction?
Do text, keyboard, reduced-motion, audio-off, cues-only, Large text, skip, and review accommodations preserve the same visible meaning?

accessibility_and_recovery_checks.status: documented and technically bounded; listening review pending

accessibility_and_recovery_checks.source: docs/guides/gui-how-to-play.md: a storage failure does not block

limits: This packet makes first-session evaluation actionable; it does not perform or represent participant evaluation.
No comprehension, accessibility, educational, classroom, audio-usefulness, or fatigue score is inferred from source tests.
The separate Competitive campaign coverage complete item remains open for full-campaign product/content review and structured human evaluation.
This packet creates no runtime, simulation, asset, audio, persistence, screenshot, route, or release artifact.
